Definition: of uncertain derivation; the jaw-bone, i.e. (by implication) the cheek or side of the face:--cheek.
BiblicalUsage: Siagon is the cheek, the jaw, and it appears where Jesus teaches His disciples how to answer insult. Whoever smites thee on the one cheek, offer also the other, and whoever smites thee on thy right cheek, turn to him the other also.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the cheek is where the gospel proves itself, because turning it takes more strength than striking back.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
